messages:
rachel (DevEx): Heads up: customer stuck during CI deploy when rotating project key. app booted with new REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY but immediately started getting 403s. short repro below.
yves (SDK): oof. were there any org keys in the image or other credential sources? we check env -> legacy env -> metadata service (IMDS) in that order.
omar (Eng): container image had REDWOOD_API_KEY baked into Dockerfile via ARG -> ENV (bad), CI updated k8s secret for REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY but image still shipped org key. requests went out with org key and hit scope rejection.
paloma (Support): customer confusion: CI said deploy succeeded, but app auth failed silently and rolled back. docs don't call out that baked-in ENV will trump rotated secrets unless image rebuilt.
yves (SDK): short-term: flip precedence when REDWOOD_PROJECT set so PROJECT_KEY takes priority over API_KEY, and add a `redwood doctor` lint that scans for both keys present. Long-term: we should prefer explicit secret sources: if REDWOOD_PROJECT set && REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY present -> use it; else fallback to instance metadata only if no explicit envs.
auth-bot: policy-check: detected REDWOOD_API_KEY in Dockerfile at build-time. Recommend secret-scan and fail builds with baked org keys.
omar (Eng): infra change: server will include header `x-redwood-auth-scope: expected=project` and structured body on auth mismatch: {code: "auth_scope_mismatch", detail: "token not valid for project <name>"}. SDK can use header to surface targeted help during onboarding.
yves (SDK): also changing retry behavior: do not retry on auth_scope_mismatch. will emit metric `auth.scope_mismatch` and tag rollout. adding one-time startup warn: "Detected both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY; if REDWOOD_PROJECT is set, project key will be used."
paloma (Support): can we add a tiny CLI helper `redwood rotate --bake-check` that fails CI if image contains org keys? would prevent this class of incidents.
yves (SDK): +1, I'll draft an RFC for rotate helper and the precedence patch. PR: https://git.internal/pulls/2500 (adds precedence fix, doctor lint, no-retry-on-auth).
rachel (DevEx): validated in staging: after patch, sample app picked up the project key without falling back to baked org key (CI build fixed). closing the loop and updating quickstart with a "Do not bake keys into images" note.
